svg.title: Undo a private commit while keeping its work staged in JupyterLab
svg.desc: 1: The private recovery-lab branch is checked out. 2: The README change remains staged. 3: The terminal performs one soft reset. 4: The staged diff still contains the work from the private commit.

g.aria-label: The private recovery-lab branch is checked out
The terminal performs one soft reset
The staged diff still contains the work from the private commit
